review_method: Actually viewed raw, actual 1x multi-background and 4x nearest-neighbor preview against identity master and four core references.

visual.identity: Adult thirty-something woman, broad square jaw/flat nose and practical gaze retained; cream tightly tied headscarf, olive smock and ochre strap edges preserved.
issues: Right kerchief silhouette touches output edge and raw side margin is insufficient; entire knot/tails need real safe space.
Neck and exposed clavicle area too long; shoulders and apron straps take too much space.
Bright eye whites and angular frown need reduction while preserving brisk practical personality.
Headscarf parallel fold stripes are finer than four-core style.
strengths: Broad square face remains distinct from sweet-face kerchief templates.
Clothing color families and securely tied kerchief visible; no unauthorized narrative props.
